name: Lisabelle no Ma 7 - Kanketsu Hen ~Hateshinaki Hontou no Monogatari~
original_name: リズベルルの魔7　完結篇～はてしなき ほんとうの物語～
source:
"To save this world, I need your power......"

Noraurd and party were blamed for the sinking of the port city Seriora. The sought a Sword King to fix their dilemma. Amid the chaos came an emissary, then many more...... spouting claims that the prophecy was coming true, that the dark fire was upon the world. The Sword Kings were powerless before the undying and immortal nihility. The might of Vilfona was trifling against its roar.

This was surely the end... when an unlikely figure saved them......!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE163748.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“为了拯救这个世界，我需要你的力量……”

诺拉德和他的政党被指责为港口城市塞里奥拉沉没的罪魁祸首。他们寻找剑王来解决他们的困境。在混乱中出现了一位使者，然后还有更多……大声宣称预言即将实现，黑暗之火正在降临世界。在不死不灭的虚无面前，剑王们是无能为力的。维尔福纳的力量在它的咆哮面前显得微不足道。

这确实是结局……当一个不可思议的人物拯救了他们时……！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE163748.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
